# NVIDIA DGX server topology originals

Downloaded November 2, 2026. © NVIDIA. Images are unmodified local copies used with visible attribution and source links. The lesson adds highlight overlays separately.

| File | Original URL | NVIDIA page |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `dgx-h100-topology.png` | https://docs.nvidia.com/dgx/dgxh100-user-guide/_images/dgx-h100-system-topology.png | https://docs.nvidia.com/dgx/dgxh100-user-guide/introduction-to-dgxh100.html#dgx-h100-200-system-topology |
| `dgx-b200-topology.png` | https://docs.nvidia.com/dgx/dgxb200-user-guide/_images/dgx-b200-system-topology.png | https://docs.nvidia.com/dgx/dgxb200-user-guide/introduction-to-dgxb200.html#dgx-b200-system-topology |
| `dgx-b300-topology.png` | https://docs.nvidia.com/dgx/dgxb300-user-guide/_images/dgx-b300-system-topology.png | https://docs.nvidia.com/dgx/dgxb300-user-guide/introduction-to-dgxb300.html#dgx-b300-system-topology |

The H100 filename is NVIDIA’s filename; the source explicitly presents it as the shared **DGX H100/H200** topology. It is used for both with that attribution. The B200 and B300 diagrams are specific to their named DGX systems, not GB200/GB300 trays.

Original dimensions: H100/H200 10795 × 6298; B200 805 × 461; B300 1100 × 720. H100/H200 and B300 have transparency and should be displayed on white. B200’s limited original resolution is retained.
